description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's diff-tree command with the --max-depth option, including setup of test cases, checks for directory traversal depth, and expectations for different scenarios.

methods.name: make_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory with a specified name and writes content to a file inside it.

methods.name: make_files
methods.description: Creates a file with given content and sets up nested directories.

methods.name: check_one
methods.description: Runs a diff-tree command with specified parameters and checks if actual output matches the expected output.

methods.name: check_trees
methods.description: Performs depth-limited diff checks on tree objects.

methods.name: check_index
methods.description: Performs depth-limited diff checks on the index against other trees or worktrees.
